j4q.formats

Class OBJFile

  • java.lang.Object
    • j4q.formats.OBJFile

  • public class OBJFile
extends java.lang.Object
    Loads and parses Wavefront OBJ files, including geometry, materials, and mesh data.

    The OBJFile class provides methods for reading OBJ and MTL files, extracting mesh parts, materials, and converting them into GameObject instances for use in 3D scenes.
